svg.title: Read a bright-fringe width from an intensity profile
svg.desc: An original ideal double-slit intensity profile has its central maximum at ruler position 3.0 cm. The nearest minima on either side can be read from the 0.1 cm ruler. The graph is a model, not a measured photograph.

g.text: Use the nearest intensity minimum on each side of the central axis.
Ideal narrow-slit model; the 0.1 cm ruler and curve share one horizontal scale.
